trace.approvals_confirmed: Finance Director approval required before finalizing any increase above 5% (Policy Rule 2), including the 7% counter-offer proposed in the draft; Final decision to accept, reject, or escalate to competitive bidding if Acme insists on 12% or higher requires human/Finance Director sign-off; Exchange rate used for competitor quotes (1 USD = 95.82 INR, marked as LIVE/unverified) should be verified by a human before being relied upon in any final negotiation or bidding decision; No renewal or final agreement should be executed without human approval, per task instructions
trace.internal_note:
- Requires Finance Director approval before any increase above 5% is finalized (policy.txt, Rule 2); increases above 10% must not be accepted per Rule 3 — 12% as proposed is out of policy.
- SLA credit of Rs 20,000 (May and July shortfalls) must be claimed before renewal per policy.txt Rule 4 — reflected in message as a request to offset against new pricing.
- Counter-offer references Clause 8.2 (7% cap) per policy.txt Rule 5 requirement to cite contract clauses.
- Competitor quotes (Zenith Cloud Pte Ltd ~Rs 2,10,804/month; Orbit Hosting Inc ~Rs 2,15,595/month) are mentioned only in general terms in the vendor email as leverage; these are indicative figures based on a live/unverified exchange rate (1 USD = 95.82 INR) and must be re-checked before being relied upon for any final decision or further vendor communication.
- Full escalation path: if Acme agrees to 7% or provides justification for up to 10%, route to Finance Director for sign-off before countersigning renewal. If Acme insists on 12% or higher, recommend proceeding to competitive bidding using the Zenith/Orbit quotes as comparators (pending rate verification).
- No renewal should be executed without human approval, per task instructions.
